name: POP MART ROBO SHOP
summary: POP MART ROBO SHOP is an automated retail concept in Santa Clarita offering collectible designer toys and blind box figures through innovative vending technology. Part of the global POP MART brand, this location provides 24/7 access to exclusive art toys and limited edition collectibles for enthusiasts throughout Southern California.
demographics: The POP MART ROBO SHOP in Santa Clarita attracts a young, tech-savvy demographic primarily consisting of millennials and Gen Z collectors aged 18-35 with disposable income for collectible toys and designer figures. The Valencia Boulevard location serves an affluent suburban community with median household incomes above the national average, drawing families and young professionals interested in pop culture, anime, and collectible art toys. The customer base includes both casual shoppers discovering blind box collectibles and dedicated collectors seeking limited edition releases from the global POP MART brand.
description: POP MART ROBO SHOP is an innovative automated retail concept located at 24201 Valencia Boulevard in Santa Clarita, California, bringing the global phenomenon of collectible designer toys to the heart of Southern California. As part of the internationally renowned POP MART brand, which operates across North America, Europe, Asia, and Oceania, this location features the company's cutting-edge ROBO SHOP technology that provides a unique, contactless shopping experience for collectible enthusiasts. The store specializes in blind box collectibles, designer art toys, and limited edition figures from popular franchises, offering customers the thrill of discovering surprise collectibles through an automated vending system. Operating daily from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM, the ROBO SHOP serves the growing community of collectors in the Santa Clarita Valley with access to exclusive releases and sought-after series. The location represents POP MART's expansion into the American market, bringing the brand's signature blend of art, design, and collectible culture to California's passionate toy collecting community.
